BMW Team Schnitzer: Based in Freilassing. Has raced BMWs since the 1960s. Back in the DTM with BMW in 2012.
Thomas Sabo AMG-Mercedes: The second HWA AG team, entered as Thomas Sabo/Mercedes-Benz Bank AMG-Mercedes. Gary Paffett won the 2005 title.
AMG-Mercedes: Run by HWA AG from Affalterbach. HWA builds and runs the Mercedes DTM cars. One of two HWA teams in 2012.
Audi Sport Team Rosberg: Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. First DTM season in 1995 with Opel. Raced Mercedes from 2000 to 2004 and Audi since 2006.
Audi Sport Team Abt Sportsline: Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2000. Mattias Ekström won the title with the team in 2004 and 2007.
BMW Team RBM: Founded by Bart Mampaey. Based in Mechelen, Belgium. New to the DTM in 2012.
Audi Sport Team Phoenix: Founded by Ernst Moser. Based in Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2006.
BMW Team RMG: Stefan Reinhold's team from Andernach. New to the DTM in 2012. Martin Tomczyk won the 2011 title and moves to BMW with the number 1.
Audi Sport Team Abt: The second Abt Sportsline team, also from Kempten. Rahel Frey and the rookie Adrien Tambay drive.
DHL AMG-Mercedes: Peter Mücke's team from Berlin. Runs Mercedes cars. Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard drives for the team.
Junge Sterne AMG-Mercedes: Persson Motorsport runs two Mercedes cars. Entered as Junge Sterne/TV-Spielfilm AMG-Mercedes.
